name: peer-retain
description: A node whose dial to a restarting peer failed (ergoplatform/ergo#2862): A - B - C on this role's jar, peer exchange off, C mining so B always has a talking peer; A is stopped, B's failed dial to A is read from B's log, A is restarted with no stored or configured peers (passive toward B) and, with no harness re-dial, the run watches until 300 s after B's first failed dial (below the node's 600 s inactiveConnectionDeadline). Base role (a node that removes a peer on its first failed dial): A removed from B's peer database and never dialled again. Candidate role: A kept, dialled by B after its restart, and caught up. A run that cannot tell (no failed dial, inbound contact from A, rediscovery of A, the other peer going quiet, a late restart) prints no result. rig/examples/peer-retain.sh.
